component.name: Bilang
component.summary: A math adventure for kids, from counting to algebra

description.p: Kiko the owl guides children from counting apples to high school algebra, trigonometry and probability. Every level starts with a hands-on lesson, wrong answers open step-by-step hints, and stacked addition, subtraction, multiplication and long division are done column by column, the way they are taught in school.
Stars, streaks, medals and confetti keep it fun, and a score sheet shows parents how each child is doing. It works offline, with no accounts or ads.
